news.titleEn: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5% before reversing as traders await Fed meeting
news.conclusionEn: The US 10-year Treasury yield briefly topped 5% on Monday for the first time since 2023 before easing back to around 4.94%, as inflation worries collided with heavy government borrowing needs just as the Fed's two-day policy meeting opens today.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10年期国债收益率一度突破5%，创2023年以来新高，美联储议息会议今日开幕。
news.whyEn: A 5% long-term borrowing cost ripples through mortgages, corporate debt and stock valuations worldwide, and it lands right as the Fed must decide between holding rates or delivering its first hike since 2023.
news.whyZh: 长期利率触及5%将波及全球房贷、企业融资与股市估值，恰逢美联储面临是否加息的关键抉择。
news.detailEn: The 10-year Treasury yield rose as high as 5.01% in New York trading on Monday, its highest level since 2023, before buyers stepped in and pushed it back down to about 4.94%. The move reflects mounting inflation anxiety combined with swelling US government and corporate borrowing needs, plus recent data showing tariffs and elevated fuel costs feeding into underlying price pressures. The Federal Reserve's Federal Open Market Committee opens its two-day meeting today, September 15, with a rate decision due Wednesday afternoon followed by a press conference. Futures markets have pushed the probability of a quarter-point hike to roughly 90%, which would be the Fed's first rate increase since 2023, a sharp reversal from expectations of a hold just weeks ago. The meeting will also produce an updated 'dot plot' showing policymakers' rate expectations into 2027.
news.detailZh: 周一纽约交易时段，美国10年期国债收益率一度攀升至5.01%，创2023年以来新高，随后买盘入场将其压回约4.94%。此轮上行反映出通胀担忧持续升温，叠加美国政府与企业融资需求膨胀，加上近期数据显示关税与高企的燃料成本正传导至核心物价。美联储联邦公开市场委员会今日（9月15日）起召开为期两天的会议，利率决议将于周三下午公布并举行新闻发布会。期货市场已将加息25个基点的概率推高至约90%，若成真将是美联储自2023年以来首次加息，较数周前普遍预期维持利率不变已大幅逆转。会议还将公布最新「点阵图」，揭示官员们对2027年利率路径的预期。

news.titleEn: Chip Stocks Tumble as AI Pacing Call Reaches Beyond Memory: Intel Drops 7%, AMD Sinks 6%, NVIDIA Pulls Back
news.conclusionEn: Semiconductor stocks sold off broadly on Monday after Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's weekend call to slow AI development, with Intel down 7%, AMD down 6% and Nvidia off 3%, dragging a chip-sector ETF down 6%.
news.conclusionZh: AI放缓呼吁引发芯片股集体抛售，英特尔跌7%、AMD跌6%、英伟达跌3%。
news.whyEn: The selloff shows how sensitive AI-linked stocks remain to safety commentary from industry leaders, even though Amodei explicitly did not call for halting AI training and Anthropic itself is deploying more AMD chips.
news.whyZh: 抛售显示AI概念股对行业领袖安全言论极为敏感，即便言论本身并未要求停止AI训练。
news.detailEn: Chip stocks fell sharply on Monday, with Intel dropping 7% to $95.96, AMD sinking 6% to $486.80 and Nvidia pulling back 3% to $212.50; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index tumbled 5.9% and the Nasdaq 100 fell about 2%. The trigger was a weekend essay from Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urging AI companies to deliberately pace their development of more powerful models, a call echoed by OpenAI's Sam Altman and Tesla's Elon Musk. Analysts noted an unusual pattern: less AI-exposed Intel fell hardest while Nvidia, the most AI-exposed name, fell least, suggesting the move reflects profit-taking in crowded trades rather than a genuine reassessment of AI chip demand — Amodei explicitly ruled out halting AI training, and Anthropic has committed to deploying AMD's new MI450 GPUs.
news.detailZh: 周一芯片股大幅下挫，英特尔股价下跌7%至95.96美元，AMD下跌6%至486.80美元，英伟达回落3%至212.50美元；费城半导体指数重挫5.9%，纳斯达克100指数下跌约2%。导火索是Anthropic首席执行官Dario Amodei周末发表文章，呼吁AI公司主动放缓更强大模型的开发节奏，OpenAI的Sam Altman与特斯拉的埃隆·马斯克均表态附和。分析师指出一个反常现象：AI关联度较低的英特尔跌幅最大，而AI关联度最高的英伟达跌幅反而最小，这表明此轮下跌更多是拥挤交易的获利了结，而非对AI芯片需求的真实重估——Amodei明确表示并非要求停止AI训练，Anthropic本身也已承诺部署AMD新款MI450 GPU。

news.titleEn: Bank of America expects third-quarter investment banking fees to fall more than 10%; shares slide
news.conclusionEn: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan said third-quarter investment banking fees will likely come in between $1.6-1.8 billion, down more than 10% from a year earlier and below Wall Street's $2 billion estimate, sending BofA shares down 5%.
news.conclusionZh: 美国银行CEO警告三季度投行费用将同比下滑超10%，股价应声重挫5%。
news.whyEn: As one of the largest US banks, Bank of America's dealmaking slowdown is a read-through for the whole investment-banking industry and suggests the AI-driven market jitters are already denting corporate deal activity.
news.whyZh: 美国银行是美国最大银行之一，其并购业务放缓预示整个投行行业活动降温。
news.detailEn: Speaking at an investor conference Monday, Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan said he now expects third-quarter investment banking fees of $1.6 billion to $1.8 billion, a more than 10% decline from a year ago and short of analysts' roughly $2 billion consensus; trading revenue is expected to be roughly flat. That marks a sharp reversal from the second quarter, when investment banking fees jumped 50% and trading revenue rose 33%. Moynihan said 'the market generally in investment banking is down 10%,' adding that Bank of America is 'not as well positioned in some of the businesses that have more activity, so we'll be down probably a bit more than that.' Shares fell about 5% in afternoon trading following the comments, part of a broader selloff in bank stocks Monday.
news.detailZh: 美国银行首席执行官布莱恩·莫伊尼汉周一在一场投资者会议上表示，预计三季度投行费用将在16亿至18亿美元之间，较去年同期下滑逾10%，低于分析师约20亿美元的普遍预期；交易收入预计大致持平。这较二季度投行费用大涨50%、交易收入增长33%的表现形成鲜明反差。莫伊尼汉表示「整体投行市场下滑了10%」，并补充道「我们在部分业务量较大的领域布局不够充分，因此跌幅可能会更大一些」。相关言论发布后，美国银行股价午盘一度下跌约5%，成为周一银行股整体抛售的一部分。

news.titleEn: Apple releases iOS 27, redesigned Siri AI
news.conclusionEn: Apple rolled out iOS 27 on Monday alongside watchOS, iPadOS and visionOS 27, headlined by the long-delayed Siri AI overhaul built using Google's Gemini models, though the new assistant launches in English-only beta with a waitlist.
news.conclusionZh: 苹果发布iOS 27，长期延迟的Siri AI重构版正式亮相，采用谷歌Gemini模型训练。
news.whyEn: The overhaul marks Apple's biggest bet yet to catch up in generative AI after repeated delays, and its partnership with rival Google to power Siri is a notable shift in the AI competitive landscape.
news.whyZh: 此次升级是苹果追赶生成式AI的重要一步，与对手谷歌合作训练Siri也标志着AI竞争格局的转变。
news.detailEn: Apple released iOS 27 on Monday, September 14, alongside watchOS 27, iPadOS 27 and visionOS 27, with a rebuilt Siri AI as the headline feature across all four platforms. The new assistant can hold multi-turn conversations, maintain context across a session, search across a user's Mail, Messages and Photos to surface personal information, take actions inside apps, and answer general questions using live web data. Apple partnered with Google, using its Gemini models to help train the algorithms behind Siri AI — a notable alliance given the two companies compete directly in AI. The feature launches as an English-only beta that requires opting in through Settings and, in some cases, joining a waitlist; support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish is planned for October. Only iPhones as far back as the iPhone 15 Pro support the new Siri AI.
news.detailZh: 苹果于9月14日周一发布iOS 27，同步推出watchOS 27、iPadOS 27和visionOS 27，四大平台的核心亮点均为重构后的Siri AI。新版助手可进行多轮对话、保持会话上下文，并可跨Mail、信息与照片应用搜索调取个人信息，执行应用内操作，还能借助实时网络数据回答一般性问题。苹果与谷歌合作，使用后者的Gemini模型协助训练Siri AI背后的算法——鉴于两家公司在AI领域直接竞争，这一合作颇为引人注目。该功能目前仅提供英语测试版，需通过设置手动开启，部分用户还需加入等候名单；法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语支持预计10月上线。仅iPhone 15 Pro及以后机型支持新版Siri AI。

news.titleEn: Kim Jong Un vows unwavering support for Putin, calls Russia's Ukraine war sacred
news.conclusionEn: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un pledged 'invariable support' to Russia in a letter to Vladimir Putin, calling the war in Ukraine a 'sacred war,' as Ukraine seeks South Korean air defenses and speculation grows over further North Korean troop deployments.
news.conclusionZh: 金正恩致信普京承诺「不变的支持」，称俄乌战争为「神圣战争」。
news.whyEn: North Korea's deepening military alignment with Russia has direct battlefield consequences, with thousands of North Korean troops already killed or wounded, and raises the stakes for South Korea and Western governments weighing further military support to Ukraine.
news.whyZh: 朝俄军事同盟持续深化，已有数千朝鲜士兵伤亡，牵动韩国及西方对乌军援决策。
news.detailEn: In a letter to Russian President Vladimir Putin published by state media on Monday, Kim Jong Un promised North Korea's 'invariable support' for Russia, describing the war in Ukraine as a 'sacred war for defending the security interests of the country and international justice.' The letter, sent in reply to Putin's congratulations on North Korea's founding anniversary, pledged to broaden cooperation with Russia 'in a comprehensive way' based on alliance ties formalized since 2022. South Korea's intelligence agency estimates roughly 6,000 North Korean soldiers have been killed or wounded fighting alongside Russian forces, and Kyiv has warned that tens of thousands more North Korean troops could eventually be deployed. Ukraine has asked South Korea for air defense systems to counter Russian missile strikes, a request Seoul has yet to answer.
news.detailZh: 朝鲜官方媒体周一公布金正恩致俄罗斯总统普京的信件，信中承诺朝鲜将给予俄罗斯「不变的支持」，并将俄乌战争称为「捍卫国家安全利益与国际正义的神圣战争」。这封信是对普京祝贺朝鲜建国纪念日的回复，信中承诺将基于2022年以来确立的同盟关系「全面」深化对俄合作。韩国情报机构估计，约有6000名朝鲜士兵在随俄军作战中伤亡，基辅方面警告称未来可能有多达数万名朝鲜士兵被派往俄罗斯。乌克兰已向韩国请求提供防空系统以应对俄罗斯导弹袭击，首尔方面尚未回应这一请求。

news.titleEn: EU envoys extend Russia sanctions by seven days to debate six-month renewal, EU presidency says
news.conclusionEn: EU ambassadors postponed the expiry of Russia sanctions covering roughly 3,000 entities and individuals by just seven days, after France joined Slovakia in pushing to delist Russian-Uzbek billionaire Alisher Usmanov on national security grounds.
news.conclusionZh: 欧盟因法国、斯洛伐克要求将寡头乌斯马诺夫除名而受阻，制裁仅延长7天。
news.whyEn: Since EU sanctions require unanimous approval from all 27 members and lapse without renewal, this dispute shows how a single contested name can threaten the entire Russia sanctions regime, with implications for Western unity on Ukraine.
news.whyZh: 欧盟制裁续期需27国一致同意，单一人物的争议凸显对俄制裁体系的脆弱性。
news.detailEn: European Union ambassadors agreed on Monday to extend the bloc's Russia sanctions regime by only seven days, until midnight on September 22, after member states failed to reach consensus on the standard six-month renewal. The sticking point is Alisher Usmanov, a Russian-Uzbek metals tycoon sanctioned in 2022 over his 'particularly close ties' to President Vladimir Putin; France has now joined Slovakia in calling for his removal from the list, with a French diplomatic source citing 'a specific national security issue.' The other 25 member states have not agreed to the delisting. EU sanctions require unanimous approval among all 27 members and must be renewed every six months, meaning disputes over even a single individual can repeatedly delay the entire package, which covers about 3,000 entities and individuals through asset freezes and travel bans.
news.detailZh: 欧盟大使周一同意将对俄制裁机制仅延长7天，至9月22日午夜，此前成员国未能就常规的六个月续期达成一致。争议焦点是俄裔乌兹别克金属大亨阿利舍尔·乌斯马诺夫，他因与俄总统普京「关系特别密切」而于2022年被列入制裁名单；法国如今加入斯洛伐克的行列，要求将其除名，一名法国外交消息人士称此举涉及「特定的国家安全问题」。其余25个成员国尚未同意将其除名。欧盟制裁续期需27个成员国一致同意，且每六个月需重新审批，这意味着哪怕围绕单一人物的争议，也可能反复拖延整套制裁方案的续期，该方案通过资产冻结和旅行禁令覆盖约3000个实体与个人。

news.titleEn: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 15
news.conclusionEn: Oil prices climbed further, with Brent crude near $108 a barrel, after Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline — a key workaround for Strait of Hormuz flows — remained shut following an attack, and Iran claimed a tanker struck a mine in the strait.
news.conclusionZh: 沙特东西输油管道遇袭停运，伊朗称有油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷，油价持续攀升。
news.whyEn: With two major supply routes now under threat simultaneously, sustained high oil prices add to global inflation pressure just as central banks including the Fed weigh interest rate decisions this week.
news.whyZh: 两大原油运输通道同时承压，油价高企将加剧全球通胀，恰逢美联储本周议息。
news.detailEn: Oil prices extended their climb, with Brent crude rising to around $108 a barrel and US crude near $102, as traders weighed compounding risks to Middle East supply. Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, a critical alternative route that lets crude bypass the Strait of Hormuz, remained offline after being shut down last week following an attack, with state oil giant Saudi Aramco yet to say when it will resume operations. Adding to the tension, Iran claimed that a tanker had struck a mine in the Strait of Hormuz itself, the world's most important oil chokepoint, through which about a fifth of global crude supply normally passes. Brent prices are now up more than 19% over the past month and over 60% higher than a year ago, underscoring how the extended disruption is feeding directly into global energy costs.
news.detailZh: 油价持续攀升，布伦特原油升至约每桶108美元，美国原油接近102美元，交易员正评估中东供应面临的多重风险。沙特阿拉伯东西输油管道——一条可绕开霍尔木兹海峡的关键替代通道——自上周遇袭关闭后仍未恢复，国家石油巨头沙特阿美尚未说明何时能恢复运营。局势进一步升级的是，伊朗方面称一艘油轮在全球最重要的原油咽喉要道霍尔木兹海峡触雷，该海峡通常承载全球约五分之一的原油运输量。布伦特原油价格过去一个月已上涨逾19%，较去年同期上涨超60%，凸显这场持续的供应中断正直接推高全球能源成本。

businessTips.explanationEn: A moat is a durable competitive advantage that protects a company's profits from competitors over the long run, much like a castle's moat keeps out invaders. Common sources of moats include network effects (a product gets more valuable as more people use it), high switching costs (it is painful or expensive for customers to leave), brand strength, economies of scale, and proprietary technology or data. Businesses without a moat may grow quickly but tend to see profits eroded as competitors copy their approach and undercut prices. Understanding what actually protects a business, rather than just its current growth rate, is central to evaluating whether a company's success can last.
businessTips.explanationZh: 护城河是指能长期保护企业利润、抵御竞争对手侵蚀的持久竞争优势，就像城堡的护城河能阻挡入侵者一样。常见的护城河来源包括网络效应（使用的人越多产品越有价值）、高转换成本（客户离开的代价很高）、品牌力、规模经济，以及专有技术或数据。没有护城河的企业可能增长很快，但往往会随着竞争对手模仿其模式、压低价格而利润被侵蚀。真正评估一家企业能否维持成功，关键不在于当下的增长速度，而在于它究竟拥有什么样的护城河。
businessTips.exampleEn: Two food delivery apps grow at similar rates, but one has built a large driver network and loyal restaurant partnerships that make it hard for a new entrant to replicate quickly, while the other has no real barrier beyond a temporary price advantage. When a well-funded competitor enters offering steep discounts, the app without a moat loses market share fast, while the one with strong network effects holds its ground.
businessTips.exampleZh: 两家外卖平台增速相近，但其中一家已建立起庞大的骑手网络和稳固的餐厅合作关系，新进入者很难快速复制；另一家除了暂时的价格优势外并无真正壁垒。当一个资金雄厚的竞争对手以大幅折扣入场时，没有护城河的平台市场份额迅速流失，而拥有强网络效应的平台则能稳住阵脚。

businessTips.explanationEn: Customer Acquisition Cost is the total amount a business spends on marketing and sales, divided by the number of new customers gained over the same period, and it is one of the most important numbers for any founder to track. A side hustle or startup can look successful in terms of sales growth while quietly losing money if CAC is higher than what each customer is actually worth over time. Founders typically compare CAC against customer lifetime value (LTV) to judge whether their growth is sustainable, with a common rule of thumb being that LTV should be at least three times CAC. Tracking CAC by channel also reveals which marketing efforts, such as paid ads versus referrals, are actually worth scaling.
businessTips.explanationZh: 获客成本（CAC）是指企业在营销和销售上的总支出，除以同期获得的新客户数量，这是每位创业者都应密切关注的核心指标之一。一项副业或初创项目即便销售额在增长，看起来一片繁荣，但如果获客成本高于客户带来的实际长期价值，实际上可能在暗中亏损。创业者通常会将获客成本与客户终身价值（LTV）进行对比，以判断增长是否可持续，常见的经验法则是LTV至少应为CAC的3倍。按渠道分别追踪获客成本，还能揭示哪些营销方式（例如付费广告与转介绍）真正值得加大投入。
businessTips.exampleEn: A founder running a subscription skincare side business spends $3,000 on Instagram ads in a month and gains 100 new subscribers, giving a CAC of $30 per customer. If the average subscriber only stays two months and spends $40 total, the business is losing money on every new customer despite steady sign-ups, prompting the founder to shift budget toward cheaper referral incentives instead.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位经营订阅制护肤品副业的创业者，一个月在Instagram广告上花费3000美元，获得100名新订阅用户，获客成本为每人30美元。若平均订阅用户只维持两个月、总消费40美元，那么尽管注册数据稳定，这家企业实际上每获得一名新客户就在亏钱，这促使创业者将预算转向成本更低的转介绍激励计划。

businessTips.explanationEn: The yield curve plots interest rates on government bonds of different maturities, from short-term bills to long-term bonds, and its shape offers a widely watched signal about investor expectations for the economy. Normally, longer-term bonds pay higher yields than short-term ones to compensate investors for tying up money longer, producing an upward-sloping curve; when short-term yields rise above long-term ones, the curve is said to 'invert,' which has historically preceded recessions. Investors also watch how quickly the curve moves and reshapes around major events like central bank meetings, since a sharp rise in long-term yields can signal inflation concerns even when short-term rates stay anchored by policy decisions. Reading the yield curve alongside the actual policy rate helps investors judge whether the market believes a central bank is ahead of or behind the inflation problem.
businessTips.explanationZh: 收益率曲线描绘的是政府债券在不同期限（从短期国库券到长期债券）上的利率水平，其形态是市场广泛关注的经济预期信号。通常情况下，长期债券收益率高于短期债券，以补偿投资者资金被更长时间占用的风险，从而形成向上倾斜的曲线；当短期收益率超过长期收益率时，曲线便出现「倒挂」，历史上这一现象往往预示经济衰退将至。投资者还会关注曲线在央行会议等重大事件前后变动与重塑的速度，因为长期收益率的急剧上升即便在短期利率被政策锚定的情况下，也可能预示通胀担忧正在加剧。将收益率曲线与实际政策利率结合解读，有助于投资者判断市场是否认为央行在应对通胀问题上「领先」还是「落后」。
businessTips.exampleEn: As the 10-year Treasury yield pushes toward 5% while the Fed debates whether to hike its short-term policy rate, an investor watching the yield curve can gauge whether long-term rates are rising because the market expects the Fed to fall behind on inflation, versus because growth expectations are improving. If the curve steepens sharply around the Fed decision, the investor may shift away from long-duration bonds to limit exposure to further rate-driven price declines.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在美联储商议是否上调短期政策利率之际，10年期美债收益率逼近5%，关注收益率曲线的投资者可以借此判断长期利率上升，究竟是因为市场认为美联储在通胀问题上「落后」，还是因为增长预期正在改善。若曲线在美联储决议前后急剧变陡，投资者可能会减持长久期债券，以降低进一步因利率变动而遭受价格下跌的风险。
